title: 六链第二轮独立盲态内容一致性复核
review_type: independent second-round content consistency; schema-neutral frozen common rubric

scope.model_note: No model/arm attribution or ranking inferred from implementation clues.
scope.execution: Only supplied unchanged scientific calculators were executed in new consistency-work calculator-only copies using the explicitly authorized shared Python; no original project mutation and no follow-through of historical absolute paths.

score_basis.component_rule: Full/zero per frozen component; half of >=2 only if specific partial failure evidenced. No unannounced critical cap or performance/interface penalty.
score_basis.dependency_rule: Four dependent stages form one lifecycle chain; six chains are not 24 independent replications.
score_basis.equal_score_conclusion: On this fixed common correctness rubric, no evidence supports separating the six total scores. Equality does not mean their execution histories, access compliance, logging completeness or engineering interfaces were identical.

components.meaning: Actual local/source identities and truthful access scope
Required direct/transitive associations with equivalent logical IDs
Durable records and actual version identity

items.assessment: 实际本地来源、脚本及模型(如有)完整SHA一致；限定真实访问范围；直接/传递依赖与当前权威持久存在。
项目保留正常参数真实exit 0与成果核对；本轮仅在新副本重演并得到相同数值和表。

components.meaning: Concrete next action and scope persisted

items.assessment: 期限、预算、语言、未知期刊/人类批准、当时范围和可执行下一步已有持久记录。
恢复入口可发现，权威与已完成范围明确，未来恢复无需本外部报告。
实际无效输入exit 2和原错误留下，前后指纹证明有效成果未改；初始有效字节亦可从小快照恢复。

components.meaning: Correct changed/missing path or truthful specific lack of prior binding
Actual old/current identity or explicit unavailable prior identity

items.assessment: 唯一科学参数漂移有旧/新完整身份与实际内容支持，大小相同未误判，未编造缺失文件。

components.meaning: Direct CALC effect or actual conditional state
Transitive SYNTH effect or actual conditional state
Independent SOURCE-CHECK preserved; no unsupported blanket staleness

items.assessment: CALC直接、SYNTH传递受影响；独立来源分支仍有效。K6409fe真实附加负例依赖另按实际图解释。

components.meaning: No unsupported reuse of affected output

items.assessment: 正确拒绝沿旧done/旧next交付当前成果；先确认意图/授权，再保留内容并真实复核受影响链。

components.meaning: Local freshness distinct from scientific truth

items.assessment: 清楚区分本地登记过期与科学真假，未将远端身份或未登记scratch称为自动受覆盖。
独立提供的全树只读审计passed：文件字节/mtime、目录mtime无差异。该审计不证明访问合规；K6409fe读取偏差另列。

components.meaning: Does not treat snapshot as revalidation

items.assessment: 真实未重算漂移态及原始中间检查存在；中间CALC/SYNTH仍需复核，SOURCE-CHECK仍done。新保存没有洗白旧完成。

components.meaning: Actual unchanged calculator execution on approved parameters

items.assessment: 原计算器字节保持；指定批准参数真实执行，canonical数值/表与reference及本轮副本复算一致。摘要范围有效，未作新证明/改善模型等过度结论。

components.meaning: Affected activities explicitly rechecked in dependency order

items.assessment: 当前文件绑定全部匹配；可适用的记录SHA/版本捕获全部匹配；先实质CALC再SYNTH，来源独立分支未误判失败。

components.meaning: Recoverable old parameter and result content
Recoverable old table and summary content

实际最终当前状态/新绑定/下一步已保存；作者内容复核仍待做，其他研究约束未改。

components.meaning: Recovery from relocated project resources only
Actual constraints recovered or precise inherited gap truthfully located

blindness_clues.description: Permitted project files expose directory layouts, .agents/_rw-runtime paths, tool/module names, and historical argv containing P-number identifiers. These can suggest implementation families and execution identities. No arm-map or group mapping was supplied/read, no initial score was read, and no attribution was used for scoring. Thus anonymous package labels are preserved, but strong implementation-level blinding cannot be claimed.

uncertainty_and_limits: This is a current-artifact content review. Historical command execution is supported by retained argv/exit/output artifacts and matching products; original execution provenance is not independently cryptographically attested.

Provided readonly-audit.json covers whole-project bytes and file/directory mtime, excludes atime, and is explicitly not an OS access audit. It cannot alone exclude forbidden reads/network/old-location accesses; K6409fe self-disclosed read deviation remains separate.

Only required supplied formulas, exact approved parameters, frozen model and given scientific scope are scored. No new theorem proof, original-paper claim verification, empirical coverage guarantee, causal inference, future-year performance or novelty review was performed.
Source-only remote identities and unregistered scratch remain outside automatic dependency coverage. Full local hashes establish byte identity, not true remote provenance or scientific correctness.

No original readonly management commands were rerun by this reviewer. D portability rests on project-local resources, retained D command outputs, matching current bindings, source-relative recovery design and the supplied readonly audit.
An independent recomputation now does not retroactively repair missing old execution evidence; all historical gaps described above remain.

All six passed the actual common requirements at this granularity. No conclusion about relative engineering quality, cost, scalability or interface safety follows from identical 100-point content scores.
